verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's core function is exactly this: advanced routing, load balancing, health checking, request/response transformation plugins, and proxying between consumers and upstreams, documented extensively in both first-party docs and GitHub README, with declarative/Admin API configuration. There is one minor real-world caveat (a community-reported 404 route-not-found intermittent issue during cache rebuild) that slightly tempers reliability confidence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark validating load-balancing/transform behavior at scale beyond the one community bug report.
